answers.core: I don't feel like anyone would go out of their way to have this added from an add-on or the asset library and use it in their shaders. If it was core, I feel like a lot of people would have a use for it.
answers.workaround: It can be worked around, and I've been doing it for years, but at this point I feel like it could be an easy way to make the visual editor much more efficient and easy to use.

title: Add a color ramp node to the visual shader editor
